description: This file defines the HeadlinesFragment class extending ListFragment, responsible for displaying a list of headlines, handling user selection, and communicating selected item positions to its host activity via the OnHeadlineSelectedListener interface.

classes.name: HeadlinesFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a list of headlines and communicates user selections to its activity.

classes.name: OnHeadlineSelectedListener
classes.description: An interface that must be implemented by activities hosting the fragment to handle headline selection events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting up the list adapter with headline data and different layouts based on Android version.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Configures the list view to highlight selections in a two-pane layout.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Ensures the hosting activity implements the selection callback interface.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks, notifying the activity and highlighting the selected item.
